d: Did Donald Trump and the United States just pull off the biggest economic U-turn in modern geopolitical history? For years, Washington lectured the world on morality and energy trade. The message to allies in Europe, as well as neutral powers like India and China, was non-negotiable: buying Russian crude directly finances Vladimir Putin’s war machine in Ukraine. Nations were pushed into signing price caps, facing secondary sanctions, and enduring the threat of 100% tariffs under the Lindsey Graham Act.
